title: Achenseebahn Dampfzahnradbahn
highlights: Aelteste dampfbetriebene Zahnradbahn Europas aus dem Jahr 1889
Historische Dampflokomotiven auf meterspuriger Trasse ueber 400 Hoehenmeter
Romantische Fahrt von Jenbach hinauf zum groessten See Tirols nach Seespitz
Direkter Anschluss an die historische Achensee-Dampfschifffahrt
kurzbeschreibung: The historic Achenseebahn has been steaming from Jenbach up to Achensee since 1889 as Europe's oldest cog railway.
beschreibung:
Steam Nostalgia from the Belle Époque

The Achenseebahn is a living piece of European railway history. Since its ceremonial opening in 1889, the historic steam locomotives have been chugging steadily from Jenbach in the Inntal across steep rack sections up to Maurach and Seespitz on the shores of Achensee.

Spectacular Route and Vintage Romance

Over a length of nearly seven kilometres, the narrow-gauge railway overcomes approximately 440 metres of elevation with gradients of up to 160 per mille. In open summer carriages, passengers enjoy the scent of coal smoke and steam while breathtaking views open up into the Inntal and onto the Rofangebirge.
